summary: Lesson 14 bugfix: goBackFromGraph() didn't have cases for the new fluidbp/fluidhr graph types added in v49, so tapping Back from Fluid Timeline (BP) or Fluid Timeline (HR) fell through to the BP modal instead of returning to the Fluid modal it was opened from. Both new graph types now route back to openFluidModal(), same as the existing 'fluid' (Fluid Trend) type. No other changes; Fluid Timeline logic itself (bracket pairing, combining, flagging) is unchanged from v49.
